cfg.kineticentityrese.entity.enable.tool: Prevents players from cheesing bosses; Entity heals after multiple player deaths.
cfg.kineticentityrese.entity.description: §aThis is authoritative server configuration. §eOnly administrators may save it, and the server revalidates every rule.
cfg.kineticentityrese.entity.radius.tool: Any non-negative radius (in blocks) around the player to check when the player dies; very large values can be expensive.
cfg.kineticentityrese.entity.rules.toolt: §eOpen the visual entity-rule editor. The main list shows models only; hover for names and rule details. Configured entities are pinned to the top with a green outline, and left-click opens editing directly. Malformed rules and entity IDs that do not currently exist are removed automatically when loaded.
msg.kineticentityrese.entity_reset.broad: §cWARNING: Player's performance is poor! §6%s §ehas regrouped and restored to full strength!
gui.kineticentityrese.module.name: KineticEntityRese
gui.kineticentityrese.module.tooltip: Manages nearby entity state resets and related restrictions after player deaths.
gui.kineticentityrese.rule_list.title: §6Entity Reset Rules
gui.kineticentityrese.rule_list.zoom_hin: §eCtrl + mouse wheel zooms the hovered entity model
gui.kineticentityrese.rule_edit.title: §6Edit Entity Reset Rule
msg.kineticentityrese.rule_edit.invalid_: §cDeath threshold must be an integer greater than or equal to 1.
gui.kineticentityrese.rule_edit.count_re: §eReal death: §fCounts a nearby tracked entity when the player actually dies and enters the normal death process.
gui.kineticentityrese.rule_edit.count_pr: §eDeath prevention: §fCounts when the player would have died but survives through a prevention mechanic such as a Totem of Undying.
gui.kineticentityrese.rule_edit.count_ca: §eCancelled death: §fCounts when another mod cancels the player death event so the death does not complete. This is separate from Totem prevention.
